reviews.title: Pure Heirloom Royalty!
reviews.comment: The fabric texture is exceptionally rich and the unstitched blouse piece matches the pallu border perfectly.

reviews.title: Heirloom Masterpiece for My Wedding Trousseau!
reviews.comment: Wore this Shahi Dulhan Banarasi saree for my royal reception in Varanasi. The pure Mulberry Katan silk is surprisingly light yet majestic, and the antique gold zardosi border glowed gracefully under the lights. Worth every rupee!

reviews.title: Authentic Silk Mark Verified Pure Zari
reviews.comment: Tested the silk threads and tested zari authenticity. The feel of handloom weave cannot be matched by powerlooms. Delivered in signature wooden luxury keepsake box with Silk Mark tag attached.

reviews.title: Temple Korvai Border Perfection
reviews.comment: The emerald green and ruby red temple contrast is breathtaking. The peacock (mayil) bootis are so sharp. Perfect for our family Karthigai Deepam pooja.

reviews.title: Ethereal Blush Pink Chanderi
reviews.comment: Feather-light drape! I was able to carry it for 8 hours without feeling any weight. The golden ashrafi bootis look so delicate and classy.
